title: UX26: clarify required evidence versus suggested preparation wording (T01/T03)
body:
## Outcome
Founders can distinguish a source-stated requirement from a suggested preparation step, and understand the unresolved contribution terminology.

## Delivery
Status: Closed (completed), 8 November 2026, on Nissan's instruction. All acceptance met on `main` `0a7d9a6` (table above). The remaining work is in open follow-ups: comprehension with real founders in **#54** (Stage 4), and verification after #45 in **#27**.
Previous status (superseded 8 November 2026): Backlog — minor observed wording/hierarchy finding; not dispatched
Priority: P2
Refs #26, #27, #43.

## Evidence and reproduction
OpenClaw T03 (`t03-actor.html`, screenshots t03-03 through t03-05) reports customer-interest evidence appearing both in the sourced Program A prerequisite and the suggested preparation sequence. Those are not contradictory facts, but the presentation does not clearly explain requirement versus order of preparation. T01 exact-brief rerun (`t01-r2-actor.html`) finds “commercialisation” and “matched contribution” unexplained; its follow-up repeats the same response instead of explaining them. Reports are preserved in #43 under research/synthetic-ux/runs/ux26-openclaw-20261107/published/followup/.

This is a synthetic interpretation supported by visible wording, not observed human confusion. Do not invent a source conflict or change an editorial step into a verified prerequisite. The separate topic-loss problem is #45.

## Acceptance
- Explain in plain language when having evidence is required by a source and when the suggested step concerns preparing it.
- Clarify terminology without asserting an applicable contribution amount, IP ownership, eligibility or source truth absent from evidence.
- Retain sourced/editorial labels, rights-gated excerpts and dated qualifiers.
- Record before/after visual review and targeted primed regression at the new head; validate comprehension with real participants later.


## Reconciliation against merged #47–#49 — 8 November 2026
By Claude (`claude-reconcile-20261108`) on Nissan's instruction. Verified on `main` at `0a7d9a6` from a fresh clone ([evidence](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/issues/23#issuecomment-6714202965); builder-run, not independent). Nothing was rebuilt.

| Acceptance | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Plain-language requirement vs preparation | Done: labelled "Requirement" and "Preparation" paragraphs under "What comes first", including the customer-evidence overlap example (`Journey.tsx`) |
| Terms clarified without asserting amounts, IP, eligibility or source truth | Done: "Terms in plain language" disclosure, captioned "Editorial explanation — not a source excerpt or an eligibility check"; no amounts or percentages (e2e asserts this) |
| Sourced/editorial labels, rights-gated excerpts and dated qualifiers kept | Done: e2e "issue 46 plain-language evidence help" opens both cleared and uncleared step evidence |
| Before/after visual review and targeted regression at the new head | Done: `docs/ux/issue47-review-evidence/` (original #46 before/after matrix and final renders) and `docs/ux/issue-46-evidence-language.md`; e2e 52/52 at `0a7d9a6` |
| Comprehension with real participants | Later research (Stage 4), not part of this issue |
